title: Validate Emergency Address Response
description: Response object containing details of the emergency address.

displayName.description: User supplied name for the phone number.

candidateAddresses.description: List of candidate addresses (only available if validationResult == NO_MATCH)

AddressValidationResultCode.description: Enum representing the result of address validation.

x-enumDescriptions.EXACT_MATCH: The address is perfect as sent
x-enumDescriptions.NEAR_MATCH: The result was a close enough match and has been corrected
x-enumDescriptions.NO_MATCH: The result is not close enough

streetNumber.description: The street number for the emergency address.

streetInfo.description: The street name of the emergency location.

city.description: The city of the emergency location.

state.description: The state or province of the emergency location.

postalCode.description: The postal code of the emergency location.

postalCodePlusFour.description: The postal code of the emergency location.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number in [E.164](https://community.sinch.com/t5/Glossary/E-164/ta-p/7537) format with leading `+`. Example `+12025550134`.
PhoneNumber.title: Phone Number
